component.name: Praxis Scanner
component.summary: Discover devices on your local network

description.p: Praxis Scanner is a native Linux desktop application for discovering devices and advertised services on a local IPv4 network.
It provides explicit, bounded TCP connection scans, read-only local route and neighbour information, and optional mDNS/DNS-SD, SSDP/UPnP, NetBIOS, and datagram-only ICMP echo checks.
ICMP round-trip time is reported only when the kernel permits unprivileged ping sockets. The application does not use raw sockets, request elevated privileges, or modify system settings.
Network discovery is best-effort. Responses may be filtered or spoofed, and a missing response does not prove that a device is offline.
